title: REFLECT: Intervention-Supported Error Attribution for Silent Failures in LLM Agent Traces
title_zh: REFLECT：面向 LLM Agent 轨迹静默失败的干预支持错误归因
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents now solve complex tasks through long plan-and-execution traces, yet the ability to locate errors in a completed traces still lags far behind, especially in the \emph{silent failure} regime. Existing approaches predict suspect steps via classifiers or LLM judges, or recover correct answers via retry, but none feed the intervention outcome back to \emph{refine the attribution itself}. We propose \methodname, a method that closes this gap by diagnosing a candidate error step, testing it through controlled replay with a diagnosis-specific patch, and using the verified outcome flip as contrastive evidence to refine the final attribution. Across four localization benchmarks spanning multi-hop reasoning across domains, \methodname achieves the highest localization accuracy among same-auditor methods across all four benchmarks, with the largest gains on structured tool-use traces, while providing actionable localization even when ground-truth answers are unavailable.
abstract_zh: LLM Agent 通过较长的规划与执行轨迹完成复杂任务，但在任务失败且错误不明显的“静默失败”（silent failure）场景中，定位出错步骤仍然困难。现有方法通常依赖分类器、LLM judge 预测可疑步骤，或通过重试恢复正确答案，但没有将干预结果反向用于改进错误归因。本文提出 REFLECT：先诊断候选错误步骤，再通过带有诊断特定补丁的受控回放进行测试，并利用输出是否被成功翻转作为对比证据来细化最终归因。在涵盖跨领域多跳推理的四个定位基准上，REFLECT 在相同 auditor 设置下均取得最高定位准确率，尤其在结构化工具使用轨迹上提升最大；同时，即使缺少 ground-truth answer，也能提供可操作的错误定位。
key_points_zh: 聚焦 LLM Agent 长轨迹中的 silent failure，即最终失败但中间错误步骤难以直接发现的场景。
REFLECT 将“诊断—补丁干预—受控回放—结果翻转验证”闭环引入错误归因，而非仅静态预测可疑步骤。
方法利用干预后结果是否改善作为 contrastive evidence，进一步精炼最终的错误步骤定位。
在四个跨领域多跳推理定位基准上，REFLECT 相比同类 auditor 方法取得最高 localization accuracy。
在结构化 tool-use traces 上收益最大，并且在没有 ground-truth answers 时仍可给出可操作的定位结果。

llm_assessment.comment: REFLECT is highly relevant because it uses replay and intervention outcomes to improve error attribution in agent execution traces.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: REFLECT 高度相关，因为它利用回放和干预结果来改进智能体执行轨迹中的错误归因。
